base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT AVG(r.XCL_088)
FROM (
  SELECT r.XCL_088
  FROM results r
  JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
  WHERE ra.XCL_069 = 'United States Grand Prix'
    AND ra.XCL_066 = 2006
  ORDER BY r.XCL_078
  LIMIT 10
) r;
